fields.Name: W1 -> S5.4 #3
fields.Description: Gate G2.32 (phase 2, dataset W1, criterion S5.4 #3): the trainer's code-version record, which every trainer run carries into the model lineage, holds the python, numpy, scikit-learn, xgboost and lightgbm versions and the thread count and seed it was given (1 of 1 pytest case), and the engine refuses a completed result whose code version lacks either: one without scikit-learn's version and one with a thread count of 0 are each refused naming the gap, with the run left Failed. It fails when TrainerRunRecorder.ApplyTrainerResultToRun skips TrainerContract.CodeVersionGaps, so a lineage-incomplete run completes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The trainer's code version records the five library versions and the thread count (1 of 1 pytest case passes), and completed results lacking scikit-learn's version or with 0 threads are each refused with the run left Failed.
